summary: Requested execution of a revised experiment that extends the measured consequence from one stranded requester to a batch: three remote reads from two nodes are queued, one ordinary leader tick confirms the newest, and the run records which admitted reads complete. Local construction runs showed both earlier reads left at index zero while only the newest completed, including one node's earlier read stalling while its own later read succeeded. This closes the recorded limitation that several remote requesters sharing a confirmation were unmeasured. Validation reports valid with execution_requested and one experiment create; recording the resulting fact and interpretation awaits the retained receipt.
